title: The Hero - Enemy Entity
description: There is an entity called 'It' by many. This entity has a very high speed and will destroy you if you dare fight it. This entity is immune to almost every damage, so fight it with a sword, not a bow. There is also a flint recipe!
body: The Hero - Enemy Entity is a Minecraft mod that adds a new entity that attacks you. There is a heartbroken entity. It spawns anywhere you roam and is called 'it' by many. It is immune to almost every type of damage, except melee. Fight it with a sword, not a bow, or you will have no chance. It will attack you anywhere you roam, so get ready for a fight. This mod also adds a flint recipe to help with your adventures.
